name: Clinical Genomics, Proteomics, Tandem Mass Spectrometry, and Pharmacogenomics

reference.source: Medical Biochemistry 5th ed / Harper's Illustrated Biochemistry 32nd ed
clinicalPearls: Liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) enables multiplexed newborn screening from dried blood spots
MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry rapidly identifies bacterial and fungal species directly from blood culture aliquots
TPMT and NUDT15 deficiency prevent 6-mercaptopurine inactivation, triggering lethal myelosuppression unless dose-reduced
Pre-treatment HLA-B*57:01 screening is mandatory to prevent fatal multi-organ abacavir hypersensitivity reactions
CYP2D6 poor metabolizers fail to activate codeine into morphine, while ultrarapid metabolizers risk fatal respiratory depression
reference.pathophysiology: High-throughput genomics and mass spectrometry decipher human molecular diversity. Pharmacogenomic single nucleotide polymorphisms alter xenobiotic clearance kinetics or HLA immune presentation. Homozygous deficiency of TPMT impairs thiopurine methylation, forcing toxic thioguanine nucleotide accumulation in bone marrow stem cells. Genetic screening allows individualized therapy and prevents severe adverse reactions.
additionalDifferentials: Codeine opioid toxicity in CYP2D6 ultrarapid metabolizers
Stevens-Johnson syndrome in HLA-B*15:02 carriers receiving carbamazepine
additionalInvestigations: Tandem mass spectrometry acylcarnitine and amino acid newborn screen profile
Pre-treatment TPMT and NUDT15 genotype or red cell enzyme activity
HLA-B*57:01 allele screening prior to abacavir initiation
CYP2D6 and CYP2C19 genotype panels for personalized analgesia and antiplatelet selection
